correctness.rationale: The product modality is exactly the rectangle-generated filter and the iterated coordinate modality is exactly the section/Fubini filter. The proof establishes both implications between equality of these filters and rectangularization. Finite filters are principal, giving the finite collapse, and the infinite T counterexample is verified symbolically. The bundled checker exhaustively confirms all finite cases in its stated range.

evidence: The 2026 paper defines each neighborhood function as a filter and defines the product filter by sets containing rectangles.
It proves the forward mix principle and states that full Kripke products validate product-box equivalence with an iterated coordinate box.

value.rationale: The 2026 semantics introduces a third modality whose relation to iterated coordinate modalities is a central structural difference from Kripke products. The theorem gives the exact local uniformization condition for eliminability, shows all finite full products collapse to the eliminable regime, and supplies a reflexive infinite witness outside it. This clarifies why genuinely nonprincipal infinite filters are mathematically necessary for the weaker neighborhood-product behavior used in the source completeness proofs.
